name: Pipedrive
description: Pipedrive is a sales-focused CRM built around a visual pipeline, letting sales teams track leads and deals as they move through stages, with automation and AI features to reduce manual data entry.
best_for: Small to mid-sized sales teams whose daily work is moving deals through a visual pipeline with an owned next activity on every deal, and who want a sales-focused CRM rather than a combined marketing-and-service suite.
features: Lead and deal management with centralized contact history
Two-way email sync across multiple accounts
Workflow automation and AI sales assistance

tiers.name: Lite
tiers.notes: Per seat/month, billed annually (US$168/seat/year). Lead, calendar and pipeline management.

tiers.name: Growth
tiers.notes: Per seat/month, billed annually (US$468/seat/year). Full email sync, automations and nurturing sequences.

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.notes: Per seat/month, billed annually (US$708/seat/year). Lead generation/routing, AI-powered multi-email tools, e-signatures.

tiers.name: Ultimate
tiers.notes: Per seat/month, billed annually (US$948/seat/year). Sandbox account, extended phone support, security alerts.

cons: No permanent free plan: evaluation runs on a 14-day trial, and every paid tier is priced per seat.

The Lite entry price does not cover full email sync, automations or nurturing sequences; Pipedrive lists those from Growth (US$39 per seat per month, billed annually), so a follow-up-automation requirement should be priced on Growth, not Lite.

Listed rates are per seat per month on annual billing (Lite is US$168 per seat per year), so the first invoice is a yearly commitment multiplied by the paid seat count; regional currency pricing, add-ons and taxes need a separate quote.
Sales-focused scope: teams that need marketing and customer-service tools on the same customer record should also price a broader suite such as HubSpot.

faq.question: What are the best Pipedrive alternatives?
faq.answer: It depends on why you are leaving. HubSpot fits teams that want marketing and service tools alongside the CRM and a free starting tier. Salesforce fits larger organizations standardizing one platform across departments. Zoho CRM fits businesses already in the Zoho suite. Freshsales and Close stay sales-first: Freshsales adds Freddy AI lead scoring, and Close puts calling, email and SMS inside the CRM. If Pipedrive's pipeline already works and the gap is email automation, check Growth before migrating.

faq.question: Does Pipedrive have a free plan?
faq.answer: No. Pipedrive offers a 14-day free trial, not a permanent free plan. When Miloosh last checked its pricing (August 22, 2026), paid plans started at Lite for US$14 per seat per month, billed annually. If a free CRM is a hard requirement, HubSpot's free tier is the closest alternative covered here.

faq.question: Which Pipedrive plan includes email sync and automations?
faq.answer: Growth. Pipedrive lists full email sync, automations and nurturing sequences under Growth (US$39 per seat per month, billed annually). Lite covers lead, calendar and pipeline management. Compare the Growth quote when automated follow-up is required, rather than using Lite's entry price.

faq.question: How much does Pipedrive cost for a five-person sales team?
faq.answer: With the annual-billing rates Miloosh last checked (August 22, 2026), five Lite seats come to 5 × US$14 = US$70 a month, or US$840 a year. Five Growth seats come to 5 × US$39 = US$195 a month, or US$2,340 a year. This is list-price arithmetic, not a quote. Confirm the payable seat count, currency, add-ons and taxes with Pipedrive.

faq.question: Should I switch away from Pipedrive or stay?
faq.answer: Name the missing capability first. A lower starting price elsewhere is not enough reason to migrate. If the gap is email sync or automation on Lite, upgrading within Pipedrive may be the lower-disruption fix. If you need marketing and service in one customer record, compare HubSpot. If process control justifies a named CRM administrator, compare Salesforce. Before switching, export a small sample and confirm that owners, stages, deal values and activities survive the export. Record your renewal date too.

alternatives.name: HubSpot
alternatives.description: A CRM platform with a free tier covering contact, deal, and pipeline management alongside marketing and service tools.
alternatives.best_for: Startups and small businesses that want to start free and scale up

alternatives.name: Salesforce
alternatives.description: A cloud-based CRM platform that centralizes customer data across sales, service, marketing, and IT.
alternatives.best_for: Larger organizations wanting one AI-enabled platform across departments

alternatives.name: Zoho CRM
alternatives.description: A cloud-based sales platform using the Zia AI assistant to manage leads, deals, and customer relationships with omnichannel engagement and no-code workflow automation.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses already using or considering the wider Zoho suite who want CRM bundled with dozens of adjacent apps

alternatives.name: Freshsales
alternatives.description: Freshworks' sales CRM, pairing kanban-style deal tracking with Freddy AI lead scoring, deal recommendations and AI email writing.
alternatives.best_for: Sales teams that want to stay sales-first but prefer AI-assisted lead scoring and a 360° customer view to Pipedrive's activity-led pipeline

alternatives.name: Close
alternatives.description: A sales CRM with built-in calling, email and SMS in one workspace, plus an AI agent for inbound lead qualification and meeting booking.
alternatives.best_for: Outbound sales teams whose daily work is calls, email and SMS that should stay inside the CRM rather than in connected tools
